info.title: Document jobs display projection addendum
info.description: The additive display response fields and safe recovery routing discriminator are documented here; this is not the complete document jobs API. Older servers may omit this projection. Recovery authority remains server-owned; recoveryKind classifies actions and recoveryPresentation selects a compatible dialog.

post.summary: Retry a proven-undelivered automatic contract send once
post.description: Uses stored data after client/authority/job locks; no request body or caller-supplied contract data. Success queues a new job and supersedes the old one atomically. Requires contract.dispatch and the document jobs accepting gate.

200.description: A new queued job; the previous job is superseded.

409.description: JOB_NOT_RETRYABLE: no new job or partial writes are committed

503.description: Document jobs are not accepting new work

retryable.description: Display hint only in requiresAttention; active and recent return false. Requires retained contractData, matching client and generation-bound authority, no manual claim, and strict proof of non-delivery, including an operator-confirmed not-delivered result after the send step; retry never uses the looser pre-send replacement. An uncertain send result is never retryable because another request could send a second contract. POST re-proves eligibility under locks and may return 409 JOB_NOT_RETRYABLE.

cancellable.description: Display hint for proven-undelivered generation-bound staff create jobs. Always false for legacy and auto_finalize jobs. POST rechecks locked proof and live claims, so a true hint may still yield 409 JOB_NOT_CANCELLABLE. requires_attention plus cancellable offers manual_send through iframe recovery; cancelled jobs have no recovery action.

documentKind.description: Safe server-side producer classification. Unknown evidence is never inferred from source or jobType alone.

displayOperation.description: Display operation only. Service-record review is reserved vocabulary with no current producer; INITIAL_FINALIZATION is generate even when manualReviewRequired is true.

failureReasonCode.description: Exact stable allowlist; unknown or raw errors are null. Always null outside failed/requires_attention. This code never grants recovery authority.

recoveryPresentation.description: Safe routing hint for staff contract recovery: iframe only for generation-bound create_document; legacy for supported unbound create_document/finalize_document; null whenever recoveryKind is null (including superseded jobs). Does not expose generation, payload or authority. Older servers may omit this field: finalize can use legacy; unknown-generation create must fail closed. Backend authority checks still apply.
